card.name: Foreign-language names in parentheses
card.fires_on: Pieces of foreign-language names and glosses inside parentheses, such as Russian or Slovene titles after "Russian:" or "Slovene:". It also fires on scattered ordinary words in web text.

modes.label: Russian name
modes.description: The period or first letter inside a Russian institute name given in parentheses.

modes.label: Slovene name
modes.description: Parts of a Slovene place name after "Slovene:".

modes.label: Scattered web words
